attributes.name: TAG
attributes.description: Identifier of the business process, e.g. PROC12

attributes.name: DESCRIPTION
attributes.description: Main text of the business process

attributes.name: OBJECT_ID
attributes.description: EA internal object ID (a number such as 495107). Not the identifier analysts type; use TAG for that.

attributes.name: BRIEF_DESCRIPTION
attributes.description: Short summary of the business process

attributes.name: BUSINESS_PRIORITY
attributes.description: Business priority of the process

attributes.name: LINE_OF_BUSINESS
attributes.description: Line of business the process belongs to

attributes.name: MAIN_OBJECTIVES
attributes.description: Main objectives of the process

attributes.name: TARGET_AUDIENCE
attributes.description: Intended audience of the process

attributes.name: ASSUMPTIONS
attributes.description: Assumptions recorded for the process

attributes.name: ADDITIONAL_INFORMATION
attributes.description: Additional information about the process

attributes.name: COMMENTS
attributes.description: Comments on the process

attributes.name: RELEASE_NUMBER
attributes.description: Release the process belongs to, e.g. R2

attributes.name: DEVELOPMENT_PACKAGE
attributes.description: Development package associated with the process

attributes.name: CLEARCASE_VERSION
attributes.description: ClearCase version of the process document

attributes.name: CLEARCASE_FOLDER_LINK
attributes.description: Link to the ClearCase folder for the process

attributes.name: MODIFIED_DATE
attributes.description: Date and time the process was last modified

attributes.name: TAG
attributes.description: Identifier of the business process step, e.g. PSTP177

attributes.name: DESCRIPTION
attributes.description: Title of the business process step, e.g. 'RP008-06.02.00 Create new File Locations'

attributes.name: OBJECT_ID
attributes.description: EA internal object ID (a number such as 495107). Not the identifier analysts type; use TAG for that.

attributes.name: STATUS
attributes.description: Approval status of the step, e.g. Approved

attributes.name: RELEASE_NUMBER
attributes.description: Release the step belongs to, e.g. R2

attributes.name: TRACES_TO_UC_OR_PROC
attributes.description: Yes/No flag: whether the step traces to a System Use Case or Business Process. A flag only; never used for joins.

attributes.name: CLEARCASE_VERSION_NUMBER
attributes.description: ClearCase version number of the step

attributes.name: TAG
attributes.description: Identifier of the system use case, e.g. UC45

attributes.name: DESCRIPTION
attributes.description: Main text of the system use case

attributes.name: OBJECT_ID
attributes.description: EA internal object ID (a number such as 495107). Not the identifier analysts type; use TAG for that.

attributes.name: BRIEF_DESCRIPTION
attributes.description: Short summary of the use case

attributes.name: USER_GOAL
attributes.description: Goal the user achieves through the use case

attributes.name: PRE_CONDITION
attributes.description: Conditions that must hold before the use case starts

attributes.name: POST_CONDITION
attributes.description: Conditions that hold after the use case ends

attributes.name: STATUS
attributes.description: Status of the use case

attributes.name: FOLDER_NAME
attributes.description: Folder the use case sits in

attributes.name: HAS_ROLE_TRACE
attributes.description: Yes/No flag: whether the use case traces to a role. A flag only; never used for joins.

attributes.name: COMMENTS
attributes.description: Comments on the use case

attributes.name: MODIFIED_DATE
attributes.description: Date and time the use case was last modified

attributes.name: TAG
attributes.description: Identifier of the use case step, e.g. USTP7

attributes.name: DESCRIPTION
attributes.description: Text of the use case step

attributes.name: OBJECT_ID
attributes.description: EA internal object ID (a number such as 495107). Not the identifier analysts type; use TAG for that.

attributes.name: HAS_SOLUTION_TRACE
attributes.description: Yes/No flag: whether the step traces to a solution. A flag only; never used for joins.

attributes.name: HAS_REQUIREMENT_TRACE
attributes.description: Yes/No flag: whether the step traces to a system requirement. A flag only; never used for joins.

attributes.name: COMMENTS
attributes.description: Comments on the step

attributes.name: TAG
attributes.description: Identifier of the system requirement, e.g. SREQ3

attributes.name: DESCRIPTION
attributes.description: Requirement statement, e.g. 'System must display previously entered search criteria'

attributes.name: OBJECT_ID
attributes.description: EA internal object ID (a number such as 495107). Not the identifier analysts type; use TAG for that.

attributes.name: REQUIREMENT_TYPE
attributes.description: Type or category of the requirement

attributes.name: POTENTIAL_ACCESS_IMPACT
attributes.description: Whether the requirement may affect access, e.g. N

attributes.name: HAS_DATA_TRACE
attributes.description: Yes/No flag: whether the requirement traces to a data element. A flag only; never used for joins.

attributes.name: COMMENTS
attributes.description: Comments on the requirement

attributes.name: MODIFIED_DATE
attributes.description: Date and time the requirement was last modified

attributes.name: TAG
attributes.description: Identifier of the data element, e.g. DATA9

attributes.name: DESCRIPTION
attributes.description: Description of the data element

attributes.name: OBJECT_ID
attributes.description: EA internal object ID (a number such as 495107). Not the identifier analysts type; use TAG for that.

attributes.name: DATATYPE
attributes.description: Data type of the element

attributes.name: LENGTH
attributes.description: Length of the data element. Stored as text, so numeric comparisons are not supported.

attributes.name: DATA_VALUES
attributes.description: Allowed values for the data element

attributes.name: DATA_VALUES_CONTEXT
attributes.description: Context of the allowed values

attributes.name: IN_LDM
attributes.description: Whether the element is in the Logical Data Model

attributes.name: STATUS
attributes.description: Status of the data element

attributes.name: COMMENTS
attributes.description: Comments on the data element
